title: Movie review: ‘Edjop’ says the race is far from over
summary: Jodi Sta. Maria and Elijah Canlas anchor Katski Flores’ intelligent, visually striking film about Edjop, his political journey and the daughter who must reckon with his legacy decades after his death.
